content:
From today, iPhone users who have installed the Suno app can generate songs in the Messages app via text or voice prompts. Details are as follows.

Suno brings song generation to iMessage

Suno is one of the most popular AI song generation platforms, with over 2 million paying subscribers and 7 million songs generated daily.

In addition to its web platform, Suno also offers an iPhone app that lets users create and remix AI songs using text, recordings, or uploaded audio and video. The app also features collections of user-generated songs, editorial picks, and genre-based playlists.

Now, Suno users can also create songs directly within Apple's Messages app. After installing the Suno app, it will appear alongside other iMessage apps in the Messages app drawer, allowing users to generate songs from text prompts or voice memos without leaving the conversation.

Here's a demo of the feature in action:

Suno says users can choose a genre before generating a song, and can also regenerate different versions to compare before sending them into the conversation.

One potential limitation, according to Suno, is that both users need to have the app installed to use the feature. But for those who enjoy playing around with AI song creation, downloading the free app shouldn't be much of a hurdle.

Download Suno on the App Store.
